title: Slabbed utilization & burst-credit ledger -- APAC weekly export
summary: Weekly sheet export used by infra ops to reconcile slabbed (slot-based) fill and burst-credit accounting across APAC clusters. Focus on identifying pools with rapidly-depleting burst credits and high idle-fragmentation that are causing preemptible spillover to cheaper pools.
content:
Notes:
- This is an operational snapshot intended for planning and immediate remediation.
- Definitions: slabbed fill_factor = booked_slots / slab_capacity (0-1), burst_credit = accrued burst tokens for a pool used during sustained overfill, preemptible_spillover = % of jobs spilled to preemptible/backfill pools.

Observations from week:
- Two clusters (apac-sg-03, apac-tok-01) show sustained p95 gpu_util > 0.92 for the 3-day surge window with slab fill_factor_p95 > 0.88. Burst credits for both declined by > 45 points week-over-week.
- apac-sg-03 has high idle_fragmentation (0.21) on 16-GPU nodes correlated with job size skew (many 3-6 GPU jobs leaving 1-2 GPU unusable).
- Preemptible spillover increased from 3.2% -> 11.6% on apac-tok-01 during the midweek burst, resulting in increased tail latency for interactive customers on the Dedicated tier.

Quick implications:
- If burst-credit depletion continues, we expect automatic routing to fall back to larger-model-compatible variants in other regions, increasing cross-region egress and latency.
- Fragmentation suggests a pairing of packing-binning + small-job preemption policy change could recover ~8-12% effective capacity.

Suggested actions (short-term):
1) Throttle lower-priority batch jobs on apac-sg-03 for 36h to allow burst-credit recovery (owners: @Aisha).
2) Enable 1-week packing-experiment: aggressive bin-packing heuristics for 3-6 GPU jobs on apac-sg-03 with monitoring dash.
3) Raise soft-capacity on apac-tok-01 by 6 GPUs (temporary reserve from apac-sg-02) and monitor preemptible_spill reduction.

Follow-ups (medium-term):
- Evaluate node-size mix for APAC: consider moving 20% of new procurements to 8xA100 class to reduce fragmentation for mixed-job profiles.
- Add a burst-credit forecast signal into routing so that canary rollouts avoid pools with < 20 burst-credit remaining.

notes_for_engineers:
Measurement notes: fill_factor uses slot accounting snapshot sampled every 5m and aggregated to percentiles. idle_fragmentation computed as (sum(unavailable_gpus_due_to_frag)/total_gpus). Burst credits are pool-level tokens accrued by underutilization and consumed during sustained overfill.
Data caveats: snapshots missed 2026-06-02 03:00-04:30 UTC for apac-sg-03 due to exporter restart — p95 metrics may be biased upwards.
Immediate contact: Marco Jensen (owner), Aisha Patel (ops lead), Liang Wu (capacity model).
